original_multivariate_route: first 10000 observations of the unlabeled test suffix, independently per variable
input_normalization: separate z-score for specialist fitting prefix and test suffix; routing normalization over its observed span
score_fusion: per-specialist z-score, mean, then min-max; repeat across variables for multivariate inputs
label_usage: evaluation only; labels are not accepted by TSRouter.predict
threshold_metrics: oracle threshold independently selected for each F1 metric after scoring
release_scope: inference with pruned existing weights; no retraining and no assertion that all manuscript results have been reproduced
